gloss: to stand at a crossroads; to face a critical decision

definitions.gloss: to stand at a crossroads; to face a critical decision
definitions.explanation: To be at a turning point where an important choice must be made that will significantly affect the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm standing at a crossroads in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{岐路|きろ}→岐路：19820_kiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The company is now being confronted with a major crossroads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}った⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: Facing the crossroads of whether to change jobs or stay at his current one, he agonized for days.

notes:
A set expression using ⟦{岐路|きろ}→岐路：19820_kiro⟧ (forked road; crossroads) and ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand). Almost always used figuratively to describe facing an important life or organizational decision. The passive form ⟦{岐路|きろ}→岐路：19820_kiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる (to be placed at a crossroads) emphasizes that external circumstances are forcing the decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}つ: to stand at a crossroads in life
- ⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧な{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}つ: to face a critical crossroads
- ⟦{岐路|きろ}→岐路：19820_kiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be placed at a crossroads (passive)
- {岐路|きろ}に{立|た}った{時|とき}: when facing a crossroads

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転機|てんき}→転機：14290_tenki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach a turning point — focuses on the moment of change rather than the choice
- ⟦{正念場|しょうねんば}→正念場：13193_shounenba⟧: critical moment — emphasizes the pressure of the situation rather than the branching of paths
- ⟦{瀬戸際|せとぎわ}→瀬戸際：10554_setogiwa⟧: the brink — more urgent, implying a do-or-die situation
